items.name: Moschofilero Boutari 750 ml
items.description: Mantinia Winery, Peloponnese Soft, aromatic with white rose and orange blossom prevailing. A fresh wine full and balanced, with a long citrus aftertaste. Dry white wine, Moschofilero 100%

items.name: Lefko Gramma 750ml
items.description: Mantinia Winery, Peloponnese Bright citrus and stone-fruit aromas and a lively minerality that evokes lemon, grapefruit and peach. Balanced and refreshing. Dry white wine, Assyrtiko 60%, Sauvignon Blanc 20%, Malagouzia 20%

items.name: Emery Villare 750ml
items.description: Emery Winery, Rhodes Dodecanese A wine with wonderful balance, intense and purely fruity. In mouth is cool, fresh and velvety. Soft with golden reflections attractive and completely harmonic. Dry white wine, Athiri 70%, Sauvignon Blanc 30%

items.name: Malagouzia Akrani 750ml
items.description: Triantafyllopoulos Estate, Kos Floral aromas with citrus and botanical character. In mouth, has brilliant body, cool acidity and soft aftertaste. Dry white wine, Malagouzia 100%

items.name: Techni Alipias 750ml
items.description: Wine Art Estate, Drama Vibrant aromas of citrus, stone fruit, and delicate floral notes. Crisp and refreshing with balanced acidity and a refined minerality. Dry white wine, Sauvignon Blanc 50%, Assyrtiko 50%

items.name: Dexameni 750ml
items.description: Emery Winery, Rhodes Dodecanese Aromas from apricot, figs and grilled almonds. Fruity with pleasant minerality and mediterranean herbs. Long aftertaste with vanilla hints. Dry white wine, Chardonnay, Malagouzia

items.name: Chardonnay Κtima Akrani 750ml
items.description: Triantafyllopoulos Estate, Kos Fruity and fresh with hints of pineapple, citrus, peach and white flowers with fresh spices. Excellent acidity balance and long spicy aftertaste. Dry white wine, Chardonnay 100%

items.name: Idisma Drios 750ml
items.description: Chardonnay Wine Art Estate, Drama Barrel aged with a golden hue and fragrant notes of tropical fruit, vanilla and honey balanced by crisp acidity and a smooth, full body. Dry white wine, Chardonnay 100%

items.name: Ktima Sigala 750ml
items.description: Sigalas Estate, Santorini Explosive acidity which make the wine cool, thirsty and completely enjoyable. Delicate citrus flavour with mineral hints and a long aftertaste. Dry white wine, Assyrtiko 100%

items.name: Merastri 750ml
items.description: Michalakis Estate, Crete Cool and fresh, very intense and enjoyable. Hints of pomegranate and strawberry with full taste of acidity that comes in aftertaste. Dry rose wine, Mandilari 50%, Kotsifali 50%

items.name: Vin De Crete 750ml
items.description: Pneumatikakis Estate, Crete Complex aromas of red fruits, with flavors of unripe strawberry, sour cherry and cherry. A refreshing wine with a pleasant aftertaste. Dry rose wine, Syrah 100%

items.name: Pandora 750ml
items.description: Cavino Winery, Peloponnese Pale rose color with purple hues. Red fruits in the nose and soft and fresh in mouth. Dry rose wine, Agiorgitiko

items.name: Emery Granrose 750ml
items.description: Emery Winery, Rhodes Dodecanese Deep rose colour. Aromas from cherry, strawberry and blueberry n the nose. Unique taste, fruity and enjoyable. Dry rose wine, Mandilaria 100%

items.name: Ktima Akrani 750ml
items.description: Akrani Estate & Triantafyllopoulos winery, Kos Shiny and normal tension rose colour. Fresh distinctive fruity and floral aromas. Cool, soft, fresh and peppery in mouth. Dry rose wine, Cabernet Sauvignon 60%, Sauvignon Blanc 40%

items.name: Variete Rose 750ml
items.description: Lalikos winery, Kavala, Eastern Macedonia Aromas of strawberry, cherry and flowers in Variete, while the mouth follows in the same light pattern, with a nice balance of freshness-sweetness and a fruity aftertaste. Medium Dry rose wine, Grenache Rouge 100%

items.name: Mega Spileo 750ml
items.description: Mega Spileo Estate, Achaia, Peloponnese Faint ros color with "saumon" shades. Aromas of citrus fruits, unripe fruits of the forest against a background of mild botany. In the mouth leaves an exuberant and cool feeling with a fruity aftertaste. Dry rose wine, Malagouzia 70%, Cabernet Franc 30%

items.name: Techni Alipias 750ml
items.description: Wine Art Estate, Drama Aromas of fresh strawberries, rose petals and a hint of citrus zest. Crisp and refreshing with balanced acidity and a delicate minerality. Dry rose wine, Syrah 100%

items.name: Xinomavro 750ml
items.description: Gerovassiliou Winery, Epanomi A lively nose that refers mainly to red fruits such as strawberry and cherry, while not missing a hint of lemon verbena and an almost imperceptible passage of spices. It is aristocratic and elegant, with a refreshing acidity that balances the alcohol, creating a sense of harmony and has a pleasant fruity finish. Dry rose wine, Xinomavro 100%

items.name: Merastri 750ml
items.description: Michalakis Estate, Crete Sweet spices and red fruits are combined in a rich complex in total. Soft tannins and acidity that makes it cool in taste. Dry red wine, Mandilari 50%, Kotsifali 50%

items.name: Vin De Crete 750ml
items.description: Pneumatikakis Estate, Crete Unique aromas of blueberry, clove, bitter chocolate and nutmeg. Rich fatty flavor with a long aftertaste. Dry red wine, Cabernet - Syrah

items.name: Pandora 750ml
items.description: Cavino Winery, Peloponnese Deep red with violet hues. Aromatic character of red fruits and sweet spices with mild herbal notes. Soft tannins and good volume in the mouth. Dry red wine, Agiorgitiko, Cabernet Sauvignon

items.name: Lato 750ml
items.description: Michalakis Estate, Crete Medium Dry red wine, Mandilari 50%, Kotsifali 50%

items.name: Dikaios Oinos 750ml
items.description: Akrani Estate & Triantafyllopoulos winery, Kos Deep red color with ruby reflection. Intense aromas like cherry and cassis with hints of olive and pepper. Well-balanced acidity with result a fruity long aftertaste. Dry red wine, Merlot, Syrah

items.name: Chrisolithos 750ml
items.description: Muses Estate, Thebes Central Greece Deep purple red color with aromas of fresh red fruits. Intense taste from black fruits, spices and soft tannins. A well-made, pleasant and serious wine. Dry red wine, Merlot 100%

items.name: Emery Villare 750ml
items.description: Emery Winery, Rhodes Dodecanese Complex nose of great intensity and hints of barrel. Beautiful balance of flavours, strong structure, rich body and long aftertaste. Dry red wine, Mandilaria, Syrah

items.name: Limnio 750ml
items.description: Domain Porto Carras, Chalkidiki Expressive with aromas of ripe red berries, dried herbs and subtle hints of spice. Medium-bodied and well structured with soft tannins and balanced acidity. Dry red wine, Limnio 100%

items.name: Syrah 750ml
items.description: Akrani Estate & Triantafyllopoulos winery, Kos Ruby red color with tile shade. Aromas from matured black fruits with hints of chocolate and caramel. Velvety in the mouth, warm and rich with the elements of ageing. Dry red wine, Syrah 100%

items.name: Xinomavro 750ml
items.description: Alpha Estate, Vineyard Hedgehog, Amyndeon Florina A complex bucket of aromas and spices. Full bodied wine with hints of mature blackberry, vanilla and sundried tomato. Long barrel aftertaste with intense flavor of quince. Dry red wine, Xinomavro 100%

items.name: Limniona 750ml
items.description: Zafeirakis Estate, Thessaly Intense and impressive nose with juicy strawberries, cherries and framboise. Notes of black tea, mushrooms and herbs complement the special aromatic bouquet. On the palate it has medium body, refreshing acidity and silky tannins. Dry red wine, Limniona 100%

items.name: Nemea 750ml
items.description: Gaia Estate, Nemea Deep erythroviotic color, with aromas of great intensity, purity and complexity with components of fruit, wood, vanilla and cloves. The oiliness, the volume, the body, the structure and the taste duration complete the delicious canvas of this unusual Nemea. Dry red wine, Agiorgitiko 100%

items.name: Dolcetto, White 750ml
items.description: Emery Winery, Rhodes Dodecanese Light yellow colour and well-balanced. Intense aromas, like peach, apricot and flowers. Semi sweet white wine, Muscat 70%, Athiri 30%

items.name: Dolcetto, Rose 750ml
items.description: Emery Winery, Rhodes Dodecanese Pink color with strong aromas of peach, raisins, pear and nuts. Rich in mouth with sweet long aftertaste. Semi sweet rose wine, Mandilaria, Muscat
